correctness.rationale: Using the exact open-neighborhood definition on the ordinary 12-vertex icosahedral graph, independently reconstructed all 264 nonempty simplices with face vector (12,60,120,60,12) and integer signed boundary matrices. Independent modular ranks of ∂2,∂3,∂4 were 49,48,12. Exhaustive local-support calculation found no four-vertex nonzero H_2 classes and exactly sixty five-vertex bipyramid spheres. Independently generated the 60 oriented sphere cycles and the two explicit six-vertex octahedral witnesses, formed the full integer chain matrices A5 and A6, selected independent columns/rows modulo 101 and computed the decisive EXACT integer square determinants: det(A5[69 selected rows,69 cols])=+1, det(A6[71 selected rows,71 cols])=+1. Thus the boundaries-plus-five-sphere lattice is primitive of rank 69 and the full cycle lattice primitive of rank 71, giving L5=Z^21, H_2=Z^23, quotient Z², and L6=H2. Independent graph-isomorphism enumeration counted 120 automorphisms and the 60-element orbit. This is integral evidence beyond a mod-p rank log.
